apply_orthogonal_parametrization: apply orthogonal parametrization to a PyTorch module weight using matrix_exp, cayley, or householder maps
apply_weight_norm: apply weight normalization to decouple magnitude from direction of a module weight tensor
apply_spectral_norm: apply spectral normalization to constrain the Lipschitz constant of a module weight for GAN training
use_dynamic_trivialization: use dynamic trivialization framework with orthogonal parametrization to improve convergence
compute_orthogonal_qr: compute an orthogonal matrix Q from a tall matrix A using QR decomposition with real non-negative diagonal
